currentParagraphText: “This will only escalate matters,” Jacob sighed.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “This will only escalate matters,” Jacob sighed.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: “Are you done?” the head priest said before finally taking out his trump card. In his hand, a small token flashed into existence as he made eye contact with Jacob. “This is a direct order in accordance with the divine edict bestowed upon me. Release the creature to fight the Chosen of the Malefic Viper. Now.”
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “It’s your pet, if it dies, who cares? And if it wins, it’s your job to stop it from killing the Chosen,” the head priest shrugged. “Though I don’t feel that the higher-ups would be that upset should the Chosen of the Malefic One meet an unfortunate end.”
